## Change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and scope.

## Documentation impact — required

- Owning architecture files/sections reviewed:
- Canonical files/sections updated and what changed:
- Cross-app counterpart, codebase map/change guide, index or ADR updates (when affected):
- For a genuinely documentation-neutral change only: exact reviewed sections and why they remain accurate:

A bug fix or feature that changes behavior/invariants requires canonical updates in this PR; release notes or an audit
report alone do not qualify. Bare "N/A", "minor fix" or "docs unchanged" does not satisfy this review.

## Verification

List checks actually run, results and material limits.

- [ ] Required canonical documentation is current in this change, or a specific no-impact assessment above is justified.
- [ ] Shared contracts and counterpart documentation are aligned where affected.
- [ ] Relevant verification passed; evidence and remaining limits are recorded.

Reviewer: do not approve or merge until the documentation assessment is supported by the diff and affected references.
